item.title: Harris County juvenile judges vary widely on sending violent offenders to adult prison
item.description: When it comes to deciding whether violent juvenile offenders should finish their sentences in adult prison, Harris County judges do not always reach the same conclusions.

item.title: Plane carrying Houston passengers that crashed in Maine sat long on runway after deicing: NTSB
item.description: A preliminary NTSB report revealed the plane involved in a deadly Maine crash that carried several Houston-area passengers had spent too long on the runway after deicing.

item.title: Woman shot and killed in Houston Heights, person in custody after hours long standoff, HPD says
item.description: Houston police said when officers arrived, they found the woman lying on the sidewalk after being shot in the Heights. Police added that a man is now in custody in connection with the shooting after an hours-long standoff.

item.title: KP George appeals decision to keep Fort Bend D.A. Brian Middleton on upcoming criminal trial
item.description: After the court declined KP George's request to throw Fort Bend District Attorney Brian Middleton off the case due to alleged misconduct, the county judge's lawyers are now appealing that decision.

item.title: After a president-filled celebration, Rev. Jesse Jackson's family gathers for a private homegoing
item.description: The private memorial service at the Rainbow PUSH Coalition's headquarters on the South Side of Chicago will include only a few hundred attendees, who are expected to be mostly family members, allies and confidants.

item.title: This Week in Texas: Primary wrap up with Cornyn, Talarico, Hinojosa
item.description: This Week in Texas, we hear from Sen. John Cornyn, who's headed to a runoff with Ken Paxton, and James Talarico, who won the Democratic nomination.

item.title: Trump grieves with families during return of soldiers killed in war in the Middle East
item.description: President Donald Trump joined grieving families at Dover Air Force Base for the dignified transfer of six U.S. Army Reserve soldiers killed in Kuwait.

item.title: FAA issues flight stops, delays at IAH as weekend storm begins to sweep the Houston area
item.description: The FAA has issued flight stops and delays at Bush Intercontinental Airport as the anticipated weekend storms begin to roll in.

item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: The price of oil surged higher and showed no signs of halting its rapid climb a week after the U.S. and Israel launched major attacks on Iran that escalated into a war in the Middle East.

item.title: ABC13 Weather Watch through Sunday morning, few showers and storms linger
item.description: Scattered showers and storms are expected once again Sunday after portions of Southeast Texas picked up several inches of rain with reports of penny size hail too.
